organiser.name: Tokyo Art Book Fair (一般社団法人東京アートブックフェア); exhibition area co-organised with the Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo

last_edition.label: 15th edition (TABF 2025), two weekends: 11 to 14 and 19 to 21 Dec 2025

attendance.note: Press-reported 'over 25,000' visitors and about 300 exhibitors at the 14th edition (Nov 2024, MOT); Google snippet. Organiser's About page says each edition draws about 350 exhibitors and over 20,000 visitors.

audience.psychographics: Art, design, photography and independent publishing community with high interest in art and culture; zine makers, small presses, galleries and collectors.

ticket_price.note: 2025 edition: online timed ticket 1,000 JPY plus 165 JPY fee; same-day ticket 1,200 JPY; primary school age and under free. 2027 pricing not yet captured.

add_sponsors.brand: Hakko Bijutsu (株式会社八紘美術)
